author: SrKnightTristan
quote:
I finished this game and give my thoughts. From the start this game gets me hooked like when i was 6. If you wanna experience a 20 year old game with love and thought. You should play this Zelda. This gane runs at a butter smooth 60fps at 4k. For the switch 2 is crazy!!!!

The story 10/10
The music 10/10
Can sprint and jump 10/10
Graphics 10/10
0 bugs and frame drops 10/10

Will play again and excited for my dad to play this gane and to play the DLC for this game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
